factor_mapping: identity mapping from policy_state keys; unavailable factors are not invented
enum_normalization: Resolution enum normalized via its public .value; action preserved as public string
missing_field_policy: fail closed during adapter validation; canonical factor value becomes null only for a missing policy_state key and is never imputed from gold/action
serialization_policy: canonical evaluator serialization uses sorted JSON keys and JSON-native factor values
interface_sentinel_policy: synthetic, unscored, no gold labels, never enters Gate G v2 dataset
